def find_longest_non_palindrome_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0

    def is_palindrome(sub):
        return sub == sub[::-1]

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):

def find_max_non_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            substring = s[i:j+1]
            is_palindrome = substring == substring[::-1]
            if not is_palindrome and len(substring) > max_length:
                max_length = len(substring)

def longest_non_palindrome_substring(s):

    max_len = 0

        for j in range(i + max_len + 1, n + 1):
            substring = s[i:j]
